title: Black Backwater

ТЕЛ.name: Body
ТЕЛ.affects: surviving cold, a fight, a cave-in, a long run; some deaths are decided by the body

РАЗ.name: Mind
РАЗ.affects: hunches and exact decisions, school and instruments, talking as an equal with clever people

ЭМП.name: Heart
ЭМП.desc: How well I feel other people. Not health, not romance: noticing.
ЭМП.affects: heart-to-heart talks and making up, closeness with Nika and family, who I manage to notice in time

ВОЛ.name: Will
ВОЛ.affects: saying no, not breaking, holding on to someone, seeing it through

ДАР.name: Resonance
ДАР.desc: My link to the ones I was in other worlds.
ДАР.affects: the chill before a death, the voices of the Choir, how far back I can rewind

ДРЕЙФ.name: Drift
ДРЕЙФ.desc: How far the world has slid from the one I was born in. It grows when I bend fate to suit myself.
ДРЕЙФ.affects: small things around me stop adding up, people and endings change; with little drift the bright endings stay open

shock_first: At first I don't understand where I am. And when I do, it only gets worse.

I just died. For real, all the way to the end, and I remember all of it, every second, the way you remember yesterday. And here I am, alive, and everything around me is exactly the way it was a minute ago, before it happened.

The death already feels like a memory, as if it happened long ago and to somebody else, though only a second has gone by. But no dream hurts like this afterward. My body remembers everything down to the last breath, and my hands are shaking.
I don't understand what's happening to me. Maybe I've gone crazy. Maybe it was a premonition. Only a premonition doesn't leave the taste of that minute in your mouth.
One thing I know for sure: I'm not going back there.
shock_again: It happened again. I remember my death as clearly as an old photograph, and I'm here again, alive, a minute before it.
It's no easier for not being the first time. But at least now I know I have this minute.
shock_later: I'm here again, alive, a minute before my death, and my hands are shaking. I don't understand what's wrong with me, and some part of me already knows.

meta_entries.title: ✝ — the me next door
meta_entries.text: Ice by the bank, the green glow of a dashboard underwater. This me got into the Lada Nine and never got out. For one second I saw through his eyes.

photo_eras.color: glossy color print from a photo shop, 2000s
photo_eras.future: a picture of the future that's too clean, 2050–2061
